subject: Hosted API commit top-up, tier conversion and throttle safeguards
messages:
From: Sam Ortiz <sam.ortiz@blinkcart.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted commit — short notice top-up & tier shift

Hi Ava,

Quick note from our side: our seasonal campaign last week spiked meshed traffic and we burned through our monthly hosted commit faster than forecast. We expect another series of promotions in July — estimated incremental consumption attached (BlinkCart_forecast_Q3-Q4.csv).

Can Redwood move BlinkCart from our current 1.2B token/month commit to a 2.5B tier starting July 1? Key asks:
- firm monthly committed tokens (2.5B) and clear rate bands for overage vs burst pockets
- a soft-throttle safeguard so we don’t see latency regressions at 95th pct during campaign bursts
- any ramp pricing or prorated invoice for June -> July transition

We’re on a tight timeline — budget owner needs a simple one-page proposal to sign this week. If you need to loop legal/finance, please flag what you need and I’ll bring Elena (ops) in.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Ortiz
Head of Platform & Ops | BlinkCart
+1 415 555 0123

Attachment: BlinkCart_forecast_Q3-Q4.csv (CSV, 24 KB)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Ortiz <sam.ortiz@blinkcart.com>
Cc: Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@blinkcart.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted commit — short notice top-up & tier shift

Sam — thanks for the heads up and the attach, that helps a lot. We can absolutely support a top-up to a 2.5B monthly committed tier with a staged onboarding so you don’t see any latency surprises. High level proposal (attached PDF):

- New commit: 2.5B tokens/month, 12-month term starting 2025-07-01 (option to accelerate to quarterly billing on request)
- Intro rate: 10% discount off list on the incremental portion above 1.2B for first 3 months
- Soft-throttle safeguard: configure a campaign QoS lane with 95th-pt latency guard and a reserved burst pocket (200M tokens) to absorb spikes
- Overage: measured at per-token rate (we suggest a capped overage of 1.5x list for predictable economics)
- Ops: 2-week turnaround to change commit and validate routing; we’ll do canary traffic to confirm latency SLOs

I attached a one-page proposal (BlinkCart_MAAP_Commit_Proposal_v2.pdf) you can send to your budget owner. If that looks good, when would you be available for a 30-min call today or tomorrow? I’ll loop in Legal/Finance for the DocuSign.

Best,
Ava
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0789

Attachment: BlinkCart_MAAP_Commit_Proposal_v2.pdf (PDF, 18 pages — one-page summary included)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Jun 2025 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: BlinkCart — commit top-up (need legal/ops + pricing sign-off)

Team — forwarding BlinkCart’s request and my proposed one-pager. Quick asks and proposed timeline:

1) Legal (Marissa) — can you review the proposal and SOW Appendix B (I’ll attach the draft) for: term start date 2025-07-01, 12-month term, capped overage at 1.5x list, and DocuSign-ready language for the burst pocket? BlinkCart wants a simple doc for budget sign-off this week.
2) Pricing/Finance (Karthik) — confirm we can offer a 10% intro discount on incremental tokens for 3 months and that proration for June->July is OK. Also confirm whether we need approval for the reserved burst pocket pricing.
3) Infra/Ops (Laura) — ops lead for canary validation. We need a 2-week validation window; propose to reserve a burst pocket of 200M tokens for July campaigns. Can ops validate latency 95th of <=200ms on canary? If not, what mitigations do we need (routing, caching)?

Proposed schedule:
- Thu 26 Jun: Legal & Pricing quick review (email)
- Fri 27 Jun: Final one-pager and DocuSign sent to Sam
- Mon 30 Jun: Signed and DocuSign envelope returned; provisioning begins 1 Jul

I’ll attach SOW_Appendix_B.xlsx in the next email. Let me know blockers.

Thanks,
Ava

Attachment: BlinkCart_MAAP_Commit_Proposal_v2.pdf (resent as reference)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BlinkCart — commit top-up (legal redlines & SOW appendix)

Ava — reviewed the one-pager and Appendix B draft. High level comments (redline notes attached in SOW_Appendix_B.xlsx):

- Term & Proration: OK to start 2025-07-01. For the June->July proration, finance should invoice a pro-rata for the additional commit (Karthik to confirm exact amount).
- Overage cap: I agree with capped overage at 1.5x list but recommend adding an annualized not-to-exceed clause tied to the monthly commit (to prevent runaway charges in exceptional months).
- Burst pocket: define burst pocket as reserved capacity (non-deductible from committed amount) and include explicit auto-fallback sequencing (primary model -> quantized variant -> cheaper fallback) if latency SLOs are under threat. That protects BlinkCart and gives us operational flexibility.
- SLA exception: BlinkCart asked for 95th pct latency guard; we should include an SLO paragraph that states target 95th <=200ms on the canary profile but add force-majeure and network exception carve-outs.

I attached a redline spreadsheet with suggested language snippets. If pricing approves, I’ll prepare the DocuSign-ready contract packet (one-page summary + Appendix B + standard MSA clauses).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: SOW_Appendix_B.xlsx (Excel, redline comments inside)

From: Sam Ortiz <sam.ortiz@blinkcart.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@blinkcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted commit — short notice top-up & tier shift

Ava / team — thanks for the fast turnaround. BlinkCart accepts the proposal with the following confirmations:

- We confirm a change to 2.5B tokens/month, term begins 2025-07-01, 12 months.
- We accept the 10% intro discount on incremental tokens for the first three months.
- We accept the burst pocket as reserved capacity (200M) and the proposed auto-fallback sequencing.

We signed the one-page and executed Appendix B via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope?envelopeId=ABC-123-BLINK (signed by Elena Rivera and me). Please confirm provisioning timeline and invite the BlinkCart ops team to kickoff (prefer Wed 2 Jul 09:00 PT).

Thanks all — appreciate the speed.

— Sam
Sam Ortiz
Head of Platform & Ops | BlinkCart
